name: @kawdly/desktop-shell
description: Electron main + preload for Kawdly People. Marker package: declares the CommonJS module boundary for everything under electron/. NOT an npm workspace and NOT installable — it deliberately has no dependencies, no version and no scripts. electron + electron-builder live in the ROOT package.json (single app manifest, single version string — see Electron-Packaging-Design.md §4.7).
